notes.title: Happy Holidays + Patch 1.03 is live!
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays to all inhabitants of planet Eden!

We've prepared the third patch to Everreach: Project Eden for you! With this, we're wishing you all Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

Below is a list of the improvements and fixes we've prepared for this update.

1.03 PATCH NOTES Adjusted the sensitivity slider once more to make sure the game plays great with mouse and controller as well
 Fixed a bug where the VSync setting was not memorized when exiting and reentering the game
 Fixed a bug which caused a stutter when the camera was being rotated
 Added the option to disable Chromatic Aberration from the options in the main menu
 Fixed a bug where opening the in-game menu at the swamp chase would overlay the menu on top of the in-game view
 The F12 and print screen keys don't skip cut-scenes anymore, allowing you to take screenshots without skipping


Thank you all very much for your ongoing feedback and support!

Ede out.

notes.title: Patch 1.02 is live!
notes.notes:
Hello there, fellow inhabitants of planet Eden!

We've prepared the second patch to Everreach: Project Eden for you that focuses on fixing the controls and performance of the game. Our goal is to provide the best possible version of Nora's adventure so all feedback is appreciated!

Below is a list of the improvements and fixes we've done.

1.02 PATCH NOTES: Massively optimized checkpoint saving which should minimize the performance cost of saving progress
 Eliminated mouse smoothing from the game
 Fixed the way the aim sensitivity slider works, this should be much more useful now
 Fixed a bug which caused some of the decals to flicker


Thank you all very much for your ongoing feedback and support!

Ede out.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 is live!
notes.notes:
Hello there, fellow inhabitants of planet Eden!

We've prepared the first patch to Everreach: Project Eden for you that fixes the most pressing issues you have brought up since the launch of the game. Our goal is to provide the best possible version of Nora's adventure so all feedback is appreciated!

Below is a list of all improvements and fixes.

1.01 PATCH NOTES: Fixed a major bug where half of the game's ending was automatically skipped for some players
 Removed the camera swaying during most cut-scenes and all dialogues, greatly reduced the rest
 Modified input handling to ensure that all customized key options work as intended and replace existing keys
 The Crouch key is now available to customize in the options menu
 Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor was not available when a gamepad was connected to the PC
 Fixed a bug where the fired shots wouldn't travel through between two objects even though they should
 Fixed a bug where sprinting would be possible with L3 instead of the left switch as it was intended
 Rifle accuracy has been increased
 Fixed a bug where it was possible to pass through the droneyard barrier in mission 1
 Fixed enemies shooting through walls in mission 1
 Added the names of translators to the main menu, this is displayed when their corresponding language is selected


Thank you all very much for your ongoing feedback and support!

Ede out.
